subject: Proof window scope, acceptance lanes & ops roster
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emma Ward <emma@opticomm.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proof window scope, proposed acceptance lanes and owners

Hi Emma — thanks again for a constructive discovery call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight plan so we can turn the conversation into a focused proof window (PW) that demonstrates value for OptiCommerce.

High-level PW proposal (goal: validate retrieval+generation workflow on customer catalog)
- Window: 2 weeks (preferred start: Mon Dec 6) — deliver a readout in week 3
- Environments: Redwood hosted sandbox with data mirroring (no production connectivity)
- Success lanes (acceptance gates):
  1) Latency & throughput: 95th percentile inference latency <= 450ms for common search flows at your expected concurrency (est. 10 qps)
  2) Relevance & quality: baseline rerank accuracy uplift >= 12% on the supplied sample set (we'll define the rubric)
  3) Cost & token efficiency: estimated token cost per 1k queries within agreed budget envelope (we'll surface config knobs)
  4) Security/ops: audit log capture + evidence of data handling controls for the sandbox

Owners (proposed):
- SE lead: Monica Patel (will provision model variants, run perf baseline, and own the eval harness)
- CSM / Success: Rishi Malhotra (scheduling, acceptance criteria, business readout)
- Security/legal touchpoint: Kimberly Park (to coordinate DPA/DPL and any questionnaire follow-ups)

What we need from OptiCommerce before kickoff:
1) A representative sample of catalog + 200 annotated queries (CSV) — see attached schema (OptiCommerce_sample_schema.csv)
2) Confirmation of the acceptance lanes above or any changes you want to prioritize
3) Security point-of-contact for questionnaire & evidence (name, email)

Proposed cadence:
- Pre-kickoff (Mon Dec 6): SE prep run (Mon morning)
- Week 1: Daily stand (15m) for first 3 days, then 2x/week check-ins; SE will run smoke tests and share interim metrics
- Week 2: Focus on regression/fine-tune and final metric capture
- Readout: Wed of week 3 — 45m demo + decision on next steps

Attachments: OptiCommerce_sample_schema.csv, MVP_success_metrics.xlsx (first tab has a suggested evaluation rubric).

Ask: Please confirm the start date, the primary SPM/PO for the sample data, and whether the sandbox is acceptable for your compliance team. If you'd prefer a 3-week window instead of 2, call that out and we can adjust.

Thanks — looking forward.

--
Rishi Malhotra

rishi@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0172
From: Emma Ward <emma@opticomm.com>

Subject: Re: Proof window scope, proposed acceptance lanes and owners

Rishi — thanks for the clear write-up. This looks good and aligns with what we discussed. A few notes from our side: 

1) Window length: can we make it 3 weeks instead of 2? Our infra team prefers more time to exercise burst patterns and our product folks want an extra iteration on relevance tuning.
2) Sample data: I can get you 250 annotated queries and a product extract. Sending that by Thurs EOD.
3) Security: attaching the OptiCommerce security questionnaire (filled) — Oliver will be the point for any infra-level access questions. He flagged that sandbox logs should not contain PII; happy to discuss redaction approach.

We agree to the acceptance lanes but would like to add one business metric: conversion delta on the top-3 results during the PW (proxy via click-throughs from the sample set). Can the readout include a short section projecting impact if the PW results hold in production?

If OK, please shift kickoff to Mon Dec 6 still but make the active test window Dec 6–26 (3 weeks) and readout Dec 30.

Thanks — Emma

--
